findings.title: Incorrect Access Control
findings.sink: Access to node2Data, indices, onStackFlag, nodeStack, resSubData
findings.trigger: Access to elements in vectors without bounds checking
findings.assumptions: The vectors node1Data, link1, nextLink1, node2Data, indices, onStackFlag, nodeStack, resSubData are assumed to be correctly initialized and have valid sizes. However, the code does not explicitly check if the indices accessed in node2Data, indices, onStackFlag, nodeStack, resSubData are within their bounds.

findings.title: Resource Management Error
findings.assumptions: The size of node1Data is not controlled or limited. If node1Data is large enough, nodeStack could grow indefinitely, leading to a memory exhaustion.

findings.title: Buffer Over-read
findings.assumptions: The indices accessed in node2Data and indices are not checked against their bounds. If currentLink is out of range, this could lead to a buffer over-read.

findings.assumptions: The indices accessed in node2Data and indices are not checked against their bounds. If currentLink is out of range, this could lead to a buffer over-read.
